history_policy: Public branch rebuilt from pre-manuscript initialization; private historical source snapshots and identities retained separately.
limitation: Prior public dissemination and unreferenced GitHub commit URLs or external caches cannot be undone or guaranteed erased by changing branch history.
papergraph_distribution: Scientific summaries, graph objects, independent interface code and public numerical-source bindings only.
papergraph_withheld_source_identity_poli: Hashes and sizes may identify withheld author sources; no public access or public hash verification of unavailable bytes is implied.
